name: Wishes in Pen: Chrysanthemums in August
source:
On that fateful night, little did you know that a simple wish and a careless “yes” would turn your entire world upside down.

The reality you once knew has been replaced with one you’ve only seen in games and movies… The only difference? You’re the character and life is the player. 

As time slowly ticks down to the pivotal choice you’ll have to make, will you be able to survive the in-betweens? And can you say goodbye to the ones who matter most?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/896740058/wishes-in-pen-chrysanthemums-in-august-otome-visua/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
在那个决定命运的夜晚，你丝毫没有意识到，一个简单的愿望和一次不经意的“答应”，会让整个世界天翻地覆。

你曾经熟悉的现实被替换成了只有在游戏和电影里见过的世界……唯一的区别在于：你成了角色，而人生就是玩家。

随着关键抉择的时刻一点点临近，你能在夹缝中生存下来吗？你又能向那些最重要的人道别吗？

（来源：[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/896740058/wishes-in-pen-chrysanthemums-in-august-otome-visua]Kickstarter[/url]）
